map.移植要求内膜多厚？: How thick must endometrium be for transfer?
map.一般 ≥7–8mm、形态 A 型（三线征）较理想；<7mm 着床率下降，可用药或: Generally ≥7-8 mm with type A (trilaminar) morphology is ideal; <7 mm lowers implantation; medication or blood flow improvement may help, but thickness is not the only factor.
